body.condition: The undirected graph underlying \(G\) on \(U\cup V\) is a forest.

novel.justification: Requiring the undirected graph on all exogenous and endogenous vertices to be a forest is a backend-motivated restriction that is satisfied by singly connected finite causal networks with unshared exogenous inputs; it is neither a Beckers assumption nor the endogenous causal-tree condition of EiterLukasiewicz2006Tractable.
